plan: [This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values. In such auctions, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies. There is no prior history to learn from here. I will therefore bid my private value of $39. This ensures I win whenever the highest other bid is below $39 and pay that highest other bid.]

[I will bid my true private value of $27. In a second-price sealed-bid auction (Vickrey), bidding your value is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the highest competing bid is below your value and then pay that price, so truthful bidding maximizes expected profit. Ties are resolved randomly but do not change the incentive to bid truthfully. I submit 27 (allowed in $0.1 increments) to maximize long-run expected payoff.]
